_note: Attack speed ratio and per-level growth, VERIFIED IN GAME by the owner. Wild Rift keeps League's formula: AS(level) = ratio * (1 + growth * (L-1) * (0.7025 + 0.0175 * (L-1))). The engines applied no level scaling at all before this file existed, simulating every champion at its level-1 attack speed -- roughly 20-25% too slow at level 15.
_why_not_derived: Neither class nor attack pattern predicts growth. Every champion below except Gwen is class Mage and they span 0.0% to 2.1%; among 'caster' kits Ahri is 0.0% and Fiddlesticks 2.1%. It is a per-champion Riot stat, so entries are added only when measured, never extrapolated. A champion absent from this file keeps the old behaviour exactly.
_how_to_add: In game with no items, read attack speed at level 1 (that is the ratio) and at level 15. growth = (as15/ratio - 1) / 13.265. Check an intermediate level against the formula before trusting it.
